title: Evaluating Modern Large Language Models on Low-Resource and Morphologically Rich Languages: A Cross-Lingual Benchmark Across Cantonese, Japanese, and Turkish

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities of LLMs on low-resource and morphologically rich languages (Cantonese, Japanese, Turkish) using both automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, exact-match) and human evaluations for fluency and factual accuracy across open-domain QA, summarization, and translation tasks.

Using human evaluators to score 'Cultural Appropriateness' in a culturally grounded dialogue task, measuring whether model responses respect specific local cultural norms, pragmatics, idioms, and honorifics rather than defaulting to generic, Western, or culturally agnostic perspectives.
